comment: CWC modules seen in Silent Death V25. SPECTER uses stock ZH Generals.exe. Do not patch SPECTER public INI. Capabilities are not dropped.

RiderChangeContain.what_it_does: Hides rider objects inside a vehicle and swaps ModelCondition, WeaponSet, ObjectStatus, CommandSet, and Locomotor per RiderN slot. Used as deploy (stand vs prone) for TELs/AD.
RiderChangeContain.v25_example: ChinaHQ11 uses CWCruFakeRider_Inf_Stand / _Prone with CWCruS300CommandSet vs DeployedCommandSet.

rebuild.keep_capability: deployed vs undeployed weapon set, command set, and locomotor
rebuild.comment: Default is MANUAL. ChinaHQ11-style two-rider packed/deployed with rider-only OCLs is proven INDEPENDENT_ADD via DeployStyleAIUpdate + DEPLOYED. Other RiderChangeContain units stay MANUAL until proven.
specter_safe: Do not copy RiderChangeContain; it is CWC.exe-only.
Use stock DeployStyleAIUpdate only when prove_rider_deploy() succeeds (exactly two riders, WEAPON_RIDER1 None vs WEAPON_RIDER2 missile, Draw RIDER2, OCLs that only inject those fake riders).
Map RIDER1 packed to DefaultConditionState/PACKING and RIDER2 to DEPLOYED. WeaponSet Conditions = None vs DEPLOYED.
CommandSet swap and SET_SLUGGISH-while-deployed are NOT proven on stock ZH and must be listed as limitations.
Do not spawn CWC fake-rider infantry.

OCLSpecialPower.origin: Stock ZH module; CWC templates/OCLs are custom
OCLSpecialPower.what_it_does: Fires a SpecialPower that creates objects via OCL. CWC uses it to apply fake-rider deploy/undeploy and also for smoke grenades.

rebuild.keep_capability: button that switches deployed state and/or spawns support objects
rebuild.comment: ChinaHQ11 fake-rider OCLs are replaced by Command_Deploy (INDEPENDENT_ADD). Any OCL that spawns a real payload stays MANUAL until a unique SpecialPower (not CIA intel) is planned.
specter_safe: If the OCL only injects fake riders, replace OCLSpecialPower with stock Command_Deploy. Do not keep the module.
Smoke-grenade or other real payloads: unique SpecialPower + unique OCL on the unique Object; do not patch SPECTER SpecialPower.ini.

DeployStyleAIUpdate.what_it_does: PackTime/UnpackTime, turret only when deployed, recenter before packing.
DeployStyleAIUpdate.v25_example: China Overlord-style vehicles in ChinaVehicle.ini; ChinaHQ11 does not use this module (it uses riders instead).

specter_safe: Copy the module onto the unique Object INI. Do not patch SPECTER AIUpdate tables.
Requires Draw ConditionState for PACKING/UNPACKING/DEPLOYED if those anims exist on the W3D.
This is the SPECTER-safe replacement for RiderChangeContain stand/prone.

EnemyNearUpdate.origin: CWC house-color helper (not required on stock ZH)
EnemyNearUpdate.what_it_does: Empty module in V25 (house color / nearby-enemy hook). No gameplay keys.

rebuild.keep_capability: house-color / nearby-enemy hook if the exe honors it
specter_safe: Keep on the unique Object. If stock Generals.exe ignores it, drop only the module class, never the rest of the unit.

FireWeaponUpdate.origin: Stock ZH module used by CWC as a radar/search weapon ticker
FireWeaponUpdate.what_it_does: Periodically fires a Weapon (ChinaHQ11 uses CWCruSA10RadarWeapon).

specter_safe: Keep on the unique Object with a unique Weapon path. Do not retarget SPECTER radar tables.

pack_unpack.comment: V25 pack/unpack is not always DeployStyleAIUpdate. ChinaHQ11 encodes packed vs deployed as RIDER1 vs RIDER2 ModelConditions, WeaponSet WEAPON_RIDER1/2, CommandSet override, and SET_NORMAL vs SET_SLUGGISH locomotor.
specter_rebuild: ConditionState DEPLOYED = HQ11.HQ11 once-forward with WeaponLaunchBone PRIMARY MISSILE_C.
Locomotor SET_NORMAL vs a slower deployed locomotor copied as a unique Locomotor def.
CommandSet one unique file that contains both fire and undeploy, or two unique CommandSets swapped only if a stock Upgrade/WeaponSet path can do it without CWC.exe.
